# Build notes

These files are the working notes of the sessions that built this project. Every one was last changed on 2026-10-19, the build day, and they are kept as written.

Every figure, status and plan in them is as of its date and is not updated. A note here that says a quarter is still to be locked or scored was true when it was written. The current figures are in the [main README](../../README.md), the live record is in `results/live/`, and the notes of the pre-publication audit are in [docs/prepub/](../prepub/).
